separate_recovery_proposal.transformation: At each of the two stage-panel sprite-index sites, replace LDY #base (4 bytes) plus LEAY D,Y (2 bytes) with ADDD #base (3 bytes) plus TFR D,Y (2 bytes).
separate_recovery_proposal.static_safety_basis: Both sites use D only to construct Y; A/B/D are dead after construction at the first site. At the letter-loop site B is saved/restored, A is reloaded on the next iteration, and the conditional branch flags are produced later by DECB. The blitter consumes X/Y/U as its inputs. ADDD computes the same 16-bit modulo sum as LEAY D,Y; TFR transfers it to Y.
separate_recovery_proposal.risks_and_limitations: ADDD changes D and condition codes; safety is static reasoning only and requires assembler/build validation.
